mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at the Verona Public Library with a temperature of 83 degrees that feels closer to 93, and the moon is currently in a waning gibbous phase.

The City of Verona has released important notices for the upcoming November 3 general election, including type A, B, and C notices. Additionally, residents are encouraged to visit the city website to view sample ballots for all wards to prepare for election day.

There is plenty to do in our community today, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, and even more trivia at The Bogey Factory.

Looking at the weekly police report, on August 30, officers responded to a call regarding a vehicle versus bicyclist crash on East Verona Avenue. Fortunately, the 15 year old cyclist was not injured, and the driver was cited for failure to yield.
You can enjoy today's fantastic flavor, Chocolate Heath Crunch, any time today as the restaurant is currently open. Make sure to head over before they close their doors at 10 PM.
